mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_sms_code(phone, scene, code_hash, request_ip, failed_attempts, used_at, expires_at, create_by) VALUES (#{phone}, #{scene}, #{codeHash}, #{requestIp}, #{failedAttempts}, #{usedAt}, #{expiresAt}, 'system')
mapper.select: SELECT id, phone, scene, code_hash, request_ip, failed_attempts, used_at, expires_at, create_time FROM app_sms_code WHERE phone = #{phone} AND scene = #{scene} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_sms_code WHERE phone = #{phone} AND scene = #{scene} AND create_time >= #{start}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_sms_code WHERE request_ip = #{ip} AND create_time >= #{start}
